question.problem:
Consider the set of matrices ${A,B,C},$ where 

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ 2 & -5\end{aligned}],\,B=[\begin{aligned}0 & -4 \\ 20 & -12\end{aligned}],\,C=[\begin{aligned}4 & 5 \\ -7 & -5\end{aligned}].
$$

 
If the set is linearly dependent, find the value of $\frac{{x}_{1}}{{x}_{2}}$ from a non-zero solution of ${x}_{1}A+{x}_{2}B+{x}_{3}C=O,$ where $O$ is the $2\times 2$ zero-matrix.
question.worked_solution:
If the set is linearly dependent, then there exist ${x}_{1},{x}_{2},{x}_{3}$ not all zero such that 

$$
{x}_{1}A+{x}_{2}B+{x}_{3}C=O.
$$

Otherwise, if ${x}_{1}={x}_{2}={x}_{3}=0,$ the set is linearly independent.

Substituting the matrices $A,$ $B,$ and $C$ into the above equation, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ 2 & -5\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}0 & -4 \\ 20 & -12\end{aligned}]+{x}_{3}[\begin{aligned}4 & 5 \\ -7 & -5\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} & 0 \\ 2{x}_{1} & -5{x}_{1}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}0 & -4{x}_{2} \\ 20{x}_{2} & -12{x}_{2}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}4{x}_{3} & 5{x}_{3} \\ -7{x}_{3} & -5{x}_{3}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+4{x}_{3} & -4{x}_{2}+5{x}_{3} \\ 2{x}_{1}+20{x}_{2}-7{x}_{3} & -5{x}_{1}-12{x}_{2}-5{x}_{3}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding entries, we obtain the following system of equations:

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+4{x}_{3}=0 \\ -4{x}_{2}+5{x}_{3}=0 \\ 2{x}_{1}+20{x}_{2}-7{x}_{3}=0 \\ -5{x}_{1}-12{x}_{2}-5{x}_{3}=0.\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we consider the corresponding augmented matrix and reduce it to row echelon form using Gaussian elimination:

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 4 & 0 \\ 0 & -4 & 5 & 0 \\ 2 & 20 & -7 & 0 \\ -5 & -12 & -5 & 0\end{aligned}] &  & \begin{aligned}{R}_{3}:={R}_{3}+(-2){R}_{1} \\ {R}_{4}:={R}_{4}+5{R}_{1}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 4 & 0 \\ 0 & -4 & 5 & 0 \\ 0 & 20 & -15 & 0 \\ 0 & -12 & 15 & 0\end{aligned}] &  & \begin{aligned}{R}_{3}:={R}_{3}+5{R}_{2} \\ {R}_{4}:={R}_{4}+(-3){R}_{2}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 4 & 0 \\ 0 & -4 & 5 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 10 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

The pivot columns are  the $1$st,  $2$nd and $3$rd. Therefore, we get the system

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+4{x}_{3}=0 \\ -4{x}_{2}+5{x}_{3}=0 \\ 10{x}_{3}=0\end{aligned}
$$

which has only the zero solution ${x}_{1}={x}_{2}={x}_{3}=0.$

Consequently, ${A,B,C}$ is linearly independent.
